content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: IIIDEM has been established by the Election Commission of India with a vision to be a global Institute of repute promoting an inclusive, resilient and democratic world. Its mission is to strengthen democratic systems and election management bodies through training and capacity building, research and knowledge development, and promotion and advocacy. The notice says IIIDEM delivers its mandate through Schools and Centres offering programmes and courses in democratic governance, electoral laws, election technology and electoral processes. These are the School of Democratic Governance and Election Management, the School of Electoral Law, the School of Election Technology, the Centre for Research and Innovation, the Centre for National Trainings, and the Centre for Global Programs and International Trainings.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 6 posts in total. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Every post is filled on deputation, so applicants must hold a regular post in the grade indicated, as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government funded University or Institution. The discipline differs by post. The notice prints no separate experience requirement. The notice does not print an age limit. It says applicants should preferably have at least three years of service remaining before the date of superannuation, and that cases with lesser residual service may also be considered based on suitability and administrative requirements. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (School of Democratic Governance and Election Management, 2 posts)
rows.qualification_required: Must hold a regular post of Assistant Professor as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government funded University or an Institution (created under State / Central Law) in the discipline of Political Science, Public Administration or related field.

Must hold a regular post of Assistant Professor as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government funded University or an Institution (created under State / Central Law) in the discipline of Public Administration, Management, Media, Mass communication and journalism, Development studies or other discipline related to democracy and election management.

Must hold a regular post of Professor in the grade indicated, as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government–funded University or an Institution (under State / Central Law) in the discipline of Law.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (School of Electoral Laws, 1 post)
rows.qualification_required: Must hold a regular post of Assistant Professor, as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government–funded University or an Institution (created under State or Central Law) in the field of law.

rows.post: Assistant Professor and Head (Centre for Curriculum Development)
rows.qualification_required: Must hold a regular post of Assistant Professor as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government–funded University or an Institution (created under State or Central Law) with teaching in subjects / disciplines of Education, Political Science, Public Administration or related discipline.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay, allowances and other terms and conditions of officers appointed on deputation are governed by the University Grants Commission (UGC) regulations, as amended from time to time. The period of deputation is initially three years, which may be extended. Selected candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, issued by the authorised signatory of the parent organisation, at the time of final selection and before the appointment order is issued. The notice prints the formats of both certificates. The notice does not print a rupee amount for the pay.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in IIIDEM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts: Assistant Professor (2) and Assistant Professor – General Management (1) in the School of Democratic Governance and Election Management, Professor-cum-Dean (1) and Assistant Professor (1) in the School of Electoral Law, and Assistant Professor and Head (1) in the Centre for Curriculum Development.

faq.question: Q2. Is the IIIDEM recruitment on deputation basis?
faq.answer: Yes. The posts are filled on deputation basis. The deputation is initially for three years, which may be extended.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the IIIDEM academic posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a regular post of Assistant Professor (or Professor for the Professor-cum-Dean post) as per UGC norms, in a Central or State Government funded University or Institution, in the discipline given for the post.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for IIIDEM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply by email to [email protected] in the prescribed format. The application form is on www.iiidem.eci.gov.in. Attach your Resume/CV along with the PDF copy of the filled form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for IIIDEM deputation posts?
faq.answer: Pay is as per the UGC Scale for Assistant Professor for the Assistant Professor posts, and as per the UGC Scales for Professor for the Professor-cum-Dean post. Pay, allowances and other terms follow UGC regulations, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents are required from selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the authorised signatory of their parent organisation. These are due at the time of final selection and before the appointment order is issued.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates with less than three years of service left apply?
faq.answer: Applicants should preferably have at least three years of service remaining before superannuation. Cases with lesser residual service may also be considered based on suitability and administrative requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where will any addendum or corrigendum to the IIIDEM notice appear?
faq.answer: Any addendum or corrigendum will be posted only on the IIIDEM website, www.iiidem.eci.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Which phone numbers can candidates call for details?
faq.answer: The notice gives +91-11-25303501 and +91-11-25303475, and the email address [email protected].
